title: PR #382 · real-time shadows by default, only the bookcase reads the shadow map, and a failure falls back painted
blurb: On the Pixel 10 Pro XL, real-time shadows lost the WebGL context once many programs sampled the shadow map. This change joins the woodwork into one mesh, compiles every book with no shadow fetch, paints the lost band back onto the covers and steps the painted pieces the map casts aside, falls back to painted shadows on a lost context or a program that will not link — remembered for 30 days unless the page ran a shadow probe — turns real-time shadows on for everyone, and adds G60, G61 and a phone harness to hold it. Drawn at 8767661, the head of 29 commits (one a merge of main) over main at 118b9e0.

sheet.scopeRule: One sheet per entry point: a changed production symbol that no other changed production symbol calls, found by following the calls, not the file list, against the PR’s diff with main. A test spec is never an entry; it appears in enteredBy and in the tests layer. Code a gate runs in another process — page.evaluate, CDP Runtime.evaluate, a pnpm subprocess — is drawn as an effect, not a call edge. Two stated fictions keep a story in one run: on the page-life sheet, what the browser calls in with after boot has returned — a shader failure (three’s onShaderError calling boot’s onShaderFailure), the microtask that queues, the two context events, the restore timer and the black box’s once-a-second tick — is drawn as a loop at the end of boot; on the sampling-hook sheet, the wrappers three calls, and the read() a gate calls, are drawn as a loop at the end of the install. The ?debug panel’s apply and rebuild and the black box’s forget are visitor actions on their own, so each enters its own sheet. A changed callee is a node wherever it is reached (mountDiagnostics, applyLive, paintedPieces); unchanged callees (placeShelf, addLighting, mergeGeometries, frameBookcase, puppeteer, adb — and main’s serveDist, buildSite and checkLargeLibraryLit, since #384) are effects or requirements, never nodes; one-line predicates (samplesShadowMap, mapCastsWhatIsPainted, addressAsksForShadows) are folded into the step that reads them; pure helpers called thousands of times a frame or a cover (coverShadeAt, coverPoint, insideBook, inShadow, tileUv) are folded into the one step that loops over them; a callee reached only through a step already drawn as an effect stays under that effect — so the phone check’s DevTools reply matching (cdp-replies.ts), reached through run-one’s cdp effects, is drawn by no node. A try/finally, and a catch that releases and rethrows, is drawn as a catch that cleans up and throws the same error on, where a run takes that path; elsewhere an aside names it.
